name: overalls
description: Status band above the prompt: context weather, usage limits, and the Ponytail and Caveman levels

weather.title: Weather detail
weather.description: How much of the context forecast to show: off, minimal, normal or full

ponytail.title: Ponytail level
ponytail.description: How to show whether Ponytail is installed and its current level: off, icon or text

caveman.title: Caveman mode
caveman.description: How to show the mode the Caveman plugin runs in, when it's installed: off, icon or text

megacave.title: Offer megacave
megacave.description: List Caveman's Classical Chinese mode (megacave) in its dropdown: on or off

limits.title: Usage limits
limits.description: Show how much of your 5-hour and weekly usage is spent: on or off

cost.title: Session cost
cost.description: Show what this session has cost so far: on or off
